healthy but 100% out-of-market - all three returned well-formed Danish-domestic results (677 / 32 / 74 total matches respectively for AI Engineer-style queries) but every result was a Danish employer with no explicit visa-sponsorship wording, so none passed the Location Filter. observations: Heavy Accenture-in-India mass-posting this run: 3 near-identical "Custom Software Engineer" postings plus 2 more Accenture AI/ML roles, all correctly filtered as service/consultancy deal-breakers.

A cluster of 10 near-identical Roku Machine Learning/AI postings appeared in the freehire ml_ai category search, all Senior/Manager band (above SDE-II) and skewed toward classical ML (recommendations, ad-tech) rather than retrieval/orchestration - filtered to low fit per the scoring caution on 'Machine Learning Engineer' titles meaning model training.
Several IT-services/BPO firms appeared directly in AI Engineer searches (TCS, DXC, NTT Data, UST, Sutherland, Impetus) - all filtered as hard deal-breakers per the service/consultancy rule.

Two offshore/staffing-flavored Photon Interactive UK postings (explicitly labeled 'Offshore') were filtered - a useful signal that 'Offshore' in a title/description is as strong a red flag as 'resource' or 'bench'.

The four Danish CLIs (jobindex, jobnet, jobdanmark, jobbank) were run this time per their enabled:true toggle, deviating from the 2026-08-18 decision to leave them installed-but-skipped. Result: jobbank is Cloudflare-blocked, and the other three returned exclusively Danish-domestic postings with no stated sponsorship - zero relevant matches from ~780 combined results. This reinforces the prior skip decision; recommend disabling these four portals for routine runs (see chat).
